_note: Curated (T2c). Zoe's damage calcs are all named '...Tooltip', which the auto heuristic excludes, so the first pass resolved 0 slots. R (Portal Jump) is a blink with no damage.
_noteP: P (More Sparkles!): every few spell casts empowers Zoe's next basic attack to deal bonus magic damage (ZoePassive.mSpellCalculations 'PassiveDamage' = ByCharLevelBreakpointsCalculationPart(Level1=16, +4/lvl, breakpoints @7->+6, @12->+8, @15->+10) + StatByNamedDataValueCalculationPart(APRatio)). Both CalculationPart kinds are fully supported by FormulaInterpreter.EvaluatePart (ByCharLevelBreakpoints and StatByNamedDataValue), so PassiveDamage resolves live -- unlike several other champions' passives this pass found blocked by ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart (a different, unsupported kind; see Leona/Khazix/Lux P notes). Modeled as a P bonusEffect trigger onHit (same conditional-proc style as Sejuani/Volibear/Nocturne P; the every-Nth-cast gating is not modeled, approximated as firing on every attack).
_noteBreakE: (2026-10-20, M45 loop 23) The hit that wakes a sleeping target deals double: bonus true damage up to BreakDamageTooltip. A VsDebuffed box (ticked = the sleep landed and the waking hit dealt at least the cap).
_noteRidesP: (2026-10-20, M45 loop 43) More Sparkles!: after using an Ability, Zoe's next Attack (afterAnyAbility) - it rode every attack.
